_why: A breaker opens after 3 consecutive dead slots and blocks every later slot, and only a completed run (or an operator release) closes it, so nothing ever recovers on its own: on 2026-10-31 ten breakers had been open for 22 h to 8 days (stuck-work sweep). Half-open probe: after open_hours (times backoff_factor^probes, capped at max_interval_hours) release the breaker once so the lane's next natural slot is the probe; a RUN_DONE keeps it closed, a RUN_FAILED/RUN_TIMEOUT re-opens it at once (a release resets consecutive_dead, so without this the lane would fail three more times before re-opening). Coordinator 2026-10-31; operator: "validate all stuck agents and processes fix montior and make auto healings with claude code". Default off (§25.10.2).
_canary_why: Fable n8n design audit LQ-984 Q3.4 / Q6 #8, operator-approved 2026-11-08 (decision D7): an opened breaker on a live canary lane was a dead end — the lane was never probed, so only a human release could clear it (30 breaker rows historically, all released by hand). A canary lane may now spend a shorter budget than the fleet (2 probes, not 6): open_hours then open_hours*backoff_factor; a pass releases the breaker for good, and the SECOND failed probe is a P1 page (page_on_failure) after which a human decides REPAIR or REBUILD. The NEVER_PROBE code floor still binds: a canary lane whose id matches broker/order/stop/secret/sender/scalp/... is never probed whatever this switch says.
_never_probe_why: Additions only: scripts/lib/n8n_breaker_probe.py NEVER_PROBE is the code floor (broker, order, stop, execution, scalp, sender, telegram, secret, deploy, release, guard, position, paper, account, dof, ...) and binds every lane, canary or not. A live canary lane from the lane registry is probe-eligible only under the `canary` switch below (LQ-20261107-1007).
_holds_why: Operator hold marker: a JSON object {lane_id: reason}. A held lane is never probed, judged or re-opened by the prober.
_round2_why: Review round 2 (2026-10-31): exactly one probe slot — the breaker is re-opened (gate) as soon as the first slot after the release is requested, and that slot's verdict decides (pass releases for good); at most max_concurrent_probes lanes probe at once; a yield keeps the backoff; an unreadable holds file or lane registry starts no probe.
